$comment: Validates _source/mspdi-custom-fields.json, which is the single source of truth. It is not generated from anything and nothing is generated from it: tools/generate_mspdi_custom_fields.py reads it to check the manuscript before writing a byte.
It refuses a frame whose fieldId is not a positive integer, a frames list that is not exactly the two columns AT-40 and AT-41 want, and any key nobody declared.

alias.description: The column heading the partner's tool shows, empty until the user chooses the word. ⛔ NO maxLength here on purpose: the bound is aliasMaxLength above, stated once with the line of the XSD it was read from, and tools/generate_mspdi_custom_fields.py refuses an alias longer than it. A maxLength written here would be that number a second time and would go on stating it after the XSD moved.
